summary.decision_rule: H3 requires both a positive paired individual effect of distillation versus the hard-label refit control and a negative paired C1-C0 collective effect under the same O0. Statistical support requires the respective 95% seed-level CIs to lie strictly above and below zero. Point signs alone do not confirm H3. C2-C1 is an independent reorganization contrast.
